note: Binary bets: one object in items is one catalyst that can reprice a small or mid-cap biotech. timing confirmed means a company filing or release states the day. timing expected means the company stated a month or quarter, and date is the first day of that window so the row stays off a guessed day. status upcoming is still ahead. status resolved is already decided and needs an outcome. market_cap stays empty when the sources used do not state one. cash is null when no cash figure was read. quarters is empty when the company did not give a count that can be restated; do not invent a burn-rate runway. reported true means the figure was read from a news report rather than a company filing or company page. Optional fields, each omitted or null when unsourced: event_counter, guidance_history, short_interest, analyst_moves, prior_phase_data, and dilution. guidance_history.missed is true when that guided date passed without the event. Do not set early_warning; the site computes it. Every number in facts needs a source. Do not invent a date, a price, a percent, or a dollar amount. After editing, run npm run briefs.
